# git scratch

Add `git scratch <template-url>`: start a new repository from a template without keeping the template's history — clone it, drop the git metadata, `git init`, and record the provenance in the root commit:

```bash
$ git scratch git@github.com:octomation/go-module.git
# git clone
# git reset
# git init with scratch commit: 'built on top of git@github.com:octomation/go-module.git'
```

GitHub's "template repository" feature does this on the server side; the wish is a local, hosting-independent ("vendorless") equivalent that works with any URL, including Bitbucket mirrors and private templates.
